purpose: Second classical baseline beside PCA + LDA: linear support vector machine on the same train-only PCA features. Added on the PC on 2 Nov 2026. The user's notes of the supervisor's progression begin with 'vsm', read here as SVM; this is an interpretation, not a confirmed method name, and the baseline stands on its own as a standard comparator. Grid and selection rule fixed in this file before any SVM was fitted. Fold 10 was observed for earlier models, so the comparison is exploratory.

preprocessing.pooling: 2x2 maximum ink; isotropic factor2, no interpolation
preprocessing.normalization: PCA scores standardized with training statistics only
preprocessing.calibration: per-lead calibration pulses retained in pixels; no numeric metadata feature
preprocessing.limitation: downsampling thickens narrow strokes and merges fine detail; variable page gain retained; not lossless waveform reconstruction

svm_reduction: identical to ptbxl_v2_lda_wide: 8x8 nonoverlapping area mean -> 25,200 features (cached in data/processed/ptbxl_lda_features_v1), train-only randomized PCA (random_state = seed)

svm.estimator: sklearn LinearSVC, squared hinge, L2, dual='auto', max_iter=20000, no class weighting (matches the unweighted networks)
svm.probabilities: Platt sigmoid calibration (CalibratedClassifierCV, method='sigmoid') fitted inside the training folds only, with 3 patient-grouped folds (GroupKFold on patient_id); validation and test never used for calibration

selection_rule: Choose (PCA components, C) by validation macro ROC-AUC, then macro AP, then -BCE, then fewer components, then smaller C
threshold_policy: fixed calibrated probability >=0.5; no threshold search
test_policy: One test inference after the selected model is frozen and hashed. Fold 10 was already observed for earlier PTB-XL models, so comparisons are exploratory; no test-based tuning.

uncertainty.method: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of final test predictions
uncertainty.scope: test-sampling uncertainty conditional on this fitted model; excludes seed/training/external-domain variation
